plain: The killing of an important person, usually for political reasons.

webster.text: The act of killing or murdering, by surprise or secret assault; murder by violence.

example.quote: Why recourse was had to assassination in wch. he was not only deprived of his life but of the opportunity of vindicating his character.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 20, 1787
